    B: T.Buffer[(T.int64, T.int64), "float16"],
) -> None:

            "tir.noalias": True,
            "target": "cuda -arch=sm_120",  # RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (compute 12.0)
        }
    )

    m = A.shape[1]

    tile_m = T.int64(64)

    # grid dimensions

    num_blocks_m = (m + tile_m - 1) // tile_m

    # block indices
    bx = T.thread_binding(0, num_blocks_n, "blockIdx.x")
    by = T.thread_binding(0, num_blocks_m, "blockIdx.y")

    tx = T.thread_binding(0, tile_n, "threadIdx.x")
    ty = T.thread_binding(0, tile_m, "threadIdx.y")

    i = bx * tile_n + tx
    j = by * tile_m + ty

    with T.if_scope(i < n and j < m):
        v = A[i, j]
        B[i, j] = T.max(v, T.float16(0))
